title.zh: 将北伊罗戈省巴塔克市镇帕尔帕利孔村的名称变更为Franco村的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Palpalicong in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte, to Barrio Franco
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Barrio Palpalicong in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte, to Barrio Franco
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Palpalicong tại Thị trấn Batac, Tỉnh Ilocos Norte thành Barrio Franco
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Palpalicong ในเทศบาล Batac, จังหวัด Ilocos Norte เป็นบารริโอ Franco
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Palpalicong di Kotamadya Batac, Provinsi Ilocos Norte menjadi Barrio Franco
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Palpalicong di Perbandaran Batac, Wilayah Ilocos Norte menjadi Barrio Franco

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_5596_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of Barrio Palpalicong in the Municipality of Batac, Province of Ilocos Norte, is hereby changed to Barrio Franco,

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 21, 1969.
